system.description:
• The seafaring duelling tradition of Opal's docks and merchant fleets — fast, pragmatic, and built for the chaos of a boarding action. Less ceremonial than the inland schools, more concerned with winning than with style.
  • Deckhand's Escape: Acrobatic Escape movement increases to 20ft and can be used on any terrain without penalty.
  • Dockside Rapport: Advantage on Seamanship checks and on Charisma checks with sailors, dock workers, or maritime merchants.
